data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. Each Fisher01–25: would you choose 18, 10, or another exact catch, and is it conditional? Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run benefit is uncertain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
